assertions: Lilly will purchase Master B.'s houses — the bargain will be concluded and he will deal successfully with the seller

The seller is willing and amenable to deal: the seller's significators are strongly placed in the 7th and received, and Venus applies by trine to Saturn, lord of the 4th (the houses), perfecting the agreement between seller and property
His hopes in the matter will be fulfilled: the lord of the 7th is also lord of the 11th (his hopes)
The money will be procured in time to pay for the purchase, despite not being in hand now

The money is delayed, not lost: Mercury, lord of his 2nd (his money/substance), is retrograde, matching that his own money cannot be called in for six months — payment will require waiting / time to call it in rather than immediate cash in hand

The transaction goes through with difficulty and hard bargaining rather than smoothly at once: the Moon translates light by square aspect, though the square falling out of signs of long ascension softens it toward an easier, effectively trine-like perfection

The houses themselves are sound and not materially defective: Saturn, lord of the 4th, has no material debilities except retrogradation and cadency, which speak to delay/slow completion rather than a fault in the property
method: Lilly classical horary astrology (whole-sign/7th= seller, 4th= property, 2nd= querent's money, reception, applying aspects and translation of light)
reasoning: Seller significator Sun placed in the 7th and received by Venus in exaltation near the 7th cusp, and lord of 7th also lord of 11th (hopes), points to a willing seller and fulfilled hopes. Venus applying by trine to Saturn, lord of the 4th, perfects seller-to-property agreement, so the purchase completes. Moon translating light by square out of signs of long ascension brings the matter to perfection but with labour/contention, the long ascension mitigating the square. Mercury lord of the 2nd retrograde shows his money is presently tied up and delayed (the stated six months to call it in), but retrogradation is return/recovery, not denial, so funds are procured in time. Saturn lord of the 4th lacking material debility except retrograde and cadent shows a sound property, its debilities indicating slowness/delay only.
summary: Yes — he shall buy the houses, deal with the seller, and get the money together in time, though only after delay and hard bargaining while his money is called in.
